$comment: Knowledge Engine family — KB source scan request (issue #19 M4). Major version 1. Per-run stdin transport contract from det kb extract to the out-of-process KB source-scanner adapter (discovered by its declared outputContract). Registered on main-integration (issue #44): the request shape was already pinned by src/modules/core/kb/extract.ts KbScanRequest and defensively hand-validated by the scanner; this schema materializes that wire format as a declared contract so the adapter descriptor can name its input transport like every other shipped adapter. The scanner's own defensive validation stays authoritative at runtime; denyGlobs is the FULL merged additive glob list (structural baseline + manifest + per-scan), evaluated by the adapter BEFORE any read.
title: Design Engineering Toolkit — KB Source Scan Request (transport)

scanId.description: Caller-assigned scan identity; echoed verbatim in the payload.

kind.description: One scan kind per payload. Values are contract VALUES (adapter-declared kinds), not core coupling: src/modules/core/kb stays platform-neutral.

rootAlias.description: Echoed root-alias NAME; the payload's digest table is keyed '<rootAlias>:<aliasRelativePath>' and depends on it.

root.description: Caller gateway-resolved absolute scan root. Runtime transport only — never persisted into a contract payload.

subPath.description: Optional alias-relative subdirectory bound for this scan.

options.description: Bounded scalar options. The declared options set is empty for adapter 1.x — any option key is a scan-error payload (UNKNOWN_SCAN_OPTION), never silently ignored.

denyGlobs.description: Full merged deny-glob list (case-insensitive, full path AND basename, additive over the structural baseline). Additive per scan — never a replacement of the baseline.

id.description: The extract manifest's declared platform expectation; platform ids appear only as VALUES.
